pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: src/components/PageTransition.tsx:56 The root PageTransition wrapper around every route's children is a server-rendered framer motion.div whose initial variant is opacity 0 / y 20 (src/lib/animations.ts:121), so the served markup of every route starts invisible and the largest paint waits for hydration plus the entrance; the motion-reduce CSS override only helps visitors who set the preference, and the technique says that does not repair it.

techniques.evidence: src/components/PageTransition.tsx:56 This is the failure the technique names: a page-transition wrapper around the main content of every route that starts at zero opacity, so only script can reveal it. The className motion-reduce:opacity-100! on line 54 helps only reduced-motion visitors.

src/components/NavbarLogoGlyph.tsx:49 A 56px navbar logo rendered on every page through Navbar (imported in 15 files) gets priority, i.e. a head preload and a high fetch priority. The rule says never put a high hint on an every-route component unless it is the largest element on every route; a 56px glyph is not. `priority` is also deprecated in Next 16 in favour of preload.
src/app/layout.tsx:96 The only head-blocking script is inline, small, has no imports, and decides theme, lang and dir before paint, which is the one allowed case.

src/app/layout.tsx:108 Noto stylesheets for non-Latin scripts were removed from the head and load on demand per locale. Geist is self-hosted through next/font/local (variable 100-900 range, swap with an adjusted fallback by default), wired at line 113.
src/components/CookieConsent.tsx:98 The late, unrequested consent banner is a fixed overlay that animates with transform and opacity, not content inserted above the reader.
src/app/layout.tsx:119 The root layout mounts field LCP/INP/CLS reporting tagged by normalized route. p75 aggregation and the owner live outside this context.
